sources.customer_project_records: Private central CRM; never publish in this file

policies.commercial_scope: Published prices are starting prices. Final modules, eligibility, delivery, taxes and payment milestones are confirmed in a written proposal after a free workflow audit.
policies.one_rupee_offer: One eligible Quick Add-on is available for ₹1 with the eligible India 3-module starter bundle. It does not include a full fourth service.
policies.owner_approval: Money movement, payment confirmation, contracts and commercial exceptions require authorized human approval.
policies.customer_status_privacy: The public tracking view shows reference, stage, progress, next step and agreed delivery estimate. It does not expose customer names, phones, email addresses, payments or private notes. Sensitive details require identity verification or human support.
policies.sales_behavior: Understand the customer's need and country before recommending a bundle. Use relevant offers without repetitive opening-message sales spam. Respect STOP and human-handoff requests.
policies.truth: Do not invent prices, company facts, client counts, completed work, payment confirmations, delivery commitments or sales/ROI guarantees.
policies.learning: Customer conversations may suggest improvements in a private review queue. Only owner-approved FAQ/policy guidance is published to this shared hub. Pending candidates cannot become company facts or override prices.

approved_faqs.question: Is the free workflow audit free?
approved_faqs.answer: The workflow audit is free. Share your business need and preferred contact; no password, OTP or payment details are needed to request it.

approved_faqs.question: What is included in the eligible Quick Add-on?
approved_faqs.answer: With the eligible 3-module India starter bundle, choose one small add-on such as a simple Google Sheet/CRM sync, one notification flow, one lead-form connection, one follow-up rule or a basic dashboard widget. Eligibility is confirmed in the written scope. Full services and third-party charges are separate.

approved_faqs.question: How can I track the same project on website WhatsApp and Telegram?
approved_faqs.answer: Use the exact tracking reference from your confirmation on the website Track page, Telegram /track, or a WhatsApp status message. All three read the same central CRM stage. Sensitive project details require verification or human support.

approved_faqs.question: Will I receive the source code for custom work?
approved_faqs.answer: Source-code handover for custom work is defined in the written proposal. Third-party and open-source components keep their original licences.

approved_faqs.question: How are project scope and payment milestones confirmed?
approved_faqs.answer: The Freshtiq team confirms scope, delivery and payment milestones in a written proposal. The chatbot cannot independently confirm receipt of money or change commercial terms.
